contexts.proposed_replacement: Replace the hard choice at a positive activation state by a mixed policy $\nu \in \Delta(\{\mathrm{stop}, \mathrm{cont}\})$ rewarded with a Shannon-entropy bonus at temperature $\theta > 0$. At a negative state the entropy term enters with the opposite sign in the payoff to $P^+$. Then replace "the regularized value at a state" by "the regularized value at a positive state".
